items.name: balsa-theme
items.title: Balsa design themes
items.description: Typed inheritable design themes with React context, scoped providers, and Lucide icons for theme pickers. Installs the shared CSS theme stylesheet and framework-neutral theme core.

items.name: balsa-portal-scope
items.title: Balsa portal scope
items.description: Owns one dedicated portal host and React context so overlays can createPortal without guessing body children.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Tree-shaken Lucide icon primitive with finite sizing and stroke weight plus decorative or labelled accessibility semantics.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Typed action control with solid, soft, outline, and glass styles, rounded, pill, and FAB shapes, loading state, sizes, and Lucide icons.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Connected mutually exclusive actions with semantic color, a Glassmorphism-aware surface-to-glass default, explicit surface, solid, outline, glass, and compact code treatments; rounded or pill outer shapes; four shared sizes; responsive labels; and accessible pressed state.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact status, category, and metadata label with solid, soft, outline, and low-rim translucent glass styles, three sizes, and optional square geometry.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Typed sized navigation link with text, solid, and outline presentations, optional square geometry, and safe external-link behavior.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Semantic single-key and chord notation with individually rendered soft-default key caps, typed materials and sizes, configurable geometry, and accessible symbolic labels.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Decorative or semantic horizontal and vertical separation with typed line styles, thicknesses, orientation, and optional aligned horizontal label content.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Screen-reader-hidden text, rectangle, and circle loading placeholders with typed materials, sizing, geometry, pulse or wave motion, and reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Accessible indeterminate loading status with five sizes, semantic color, three speeds, hidden or visible label placement, and reduced-motion fallback.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Resilient labelled identity image with deterministic or custom fallback, image lifecycle state, delayed fallback, typed shapes and four sizes.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Typed inline feedback and native top-layer alert-dialog presentation with five statuses, five materials, persistent dismissal policy, focus restoration, sizing, geometry, and theme inheritance.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Labelled determinate or indeterminate task completion with safe value normalization, formatted value text, typed variants, semantic colors, sizing, geometry, and reduced-motion behavior.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Typed compact hierarchy navigation with linked ancestors, a current-page state, selectable separators, and accessible ordered-list semantics.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Consistent semantic surface with six variants, typed action-intent color, configurable corners, size or padding, and shadow for grouping related content and actions.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: Responsive application footer with a linked brand, flexible grouped navigation, configurable legal content, contacts, and named social links.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Accessible labeled native and masked input with outline, surface, soft, and glass materials; compact and default sizes; configurable geometry; password, phone, monetary, and percentage modes; validation feedback; and loading states.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Accessible multi-line input with outline, surface, soft, and glass materials; typed size and radius; rows; auto expansion; capped height; resize behavior; and validation feedback.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Native binary form selection with outline, surface, soft, and glass unchecked-control treatments, associated label, hint, three sizes, and configurable corners.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single-value and independently draggable bounded-range native sliders with horizontal and vertical orientation, formatted output, three sizes, minimum thumb gaps, keyboard, pointer, touch, and form behavior.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Native boolean setting control with switch semantics, typed materials, three sizes, configurable corners, form naming, required state, and associated guidance.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Single controlled underline-default disclosure with native semantics, fully retracted inert closed content, typed materials, natural-height motion, sizing, configurable corners, disabled state, and semantic headings.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Keyboard-accessible local and filter-panel switching with single-axis responsive overflow, inert unslotted panels, four materials, and segmented, underline, pill, or tile layouts.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Accessible native mutually exclusive choices with typed options, a default column layout, semantic selected colors, row and selected-card layouts, shared form validation, sizing, geometry, and loading behavior.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Accessible pressed-state action with typed surface, solid, outline, glass, and outline-to-solid icon treatments; semantic action colors; four sizes; and configurable corners.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: Connected single or multiple pressed-state actions with typed options, orientation, disabled items, immutable models, and complete roving keyboard focus.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: One labelled native text input with typed start/end text or Lucide addons, action slots, inline or stacked layout, shared form sizing and geometry, and complete required, disabled, loading, validated, and unvalidated behavior.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Connected options-driven disclosure collection with single or multiple models, semantic headings, disabled items, complete vertical keyboard navigation, and shared typed materials.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Clamped result navigation with bounded siblings, semantic ellipses, action-label or icon-only controls, localization, sizing, geometry, and native accessibility.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Responsive slot-first semantic table with typed materials, density, independently configurable header and row colors, stripes, hover, gridlines, sticky header, geometry, and valid loading or empty rows.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Theme-aware sized dark source and command presentation with configurable corners, text-style expansion controls, and accessible icon-only copy.

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: Compact anchored panel for a small group of related links or actions, with typed semantic color, surface, outline, soft, and glass materials, configurable width and geometry, and safe alignment.

items.name: popup
items.title: Popup
items.description: Collision-aware interactive rich content anchored to a native button with portal or contained rendering, focus entry/restoration, dismissal, typed materials, sizing, and geometry.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Delayed pointer-hover and keyboard-focus previews that preserve focus, bridge pointer movement, collision-flip, escape clipping, and inherit Balsa materials and geometry.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Collision-aware non-interactive supplementary descriptions for pointer hover and keyboard focus, with typed timing, materials, geometry, portal or contained rendering, and theme inheritance.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Typed semantic-color surface, solid, outline, soft, or glass focused dialog or bottom sheet with accessible naming, focus containment and return, Escape handling, backdrop dismissal, and background scroll locking that preserves scrolling inside the dialog.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Native modal edge panel with four sides, three extents, scrollable slots, focus/scroll management, dismissal policy, handle drag, and contained previews.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Labelled native scroll viewport with typed axes, scrollbar visibility and width, optional edge fades, geometry, native events, and exposed scroll methods.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: Labelled native file selection with drag/drop, immutable single or multiple models, type/size/count validation, loading/error states, metadata, and accessible removal.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Two-panel pointer and keyboard resize group with controlled percentage, horizontal or vertical orientation, safe limits, typed materials, handle sizes, and geometry.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One accessible fixed-length native verification-code input with semantic-colored visual cells, numeric or alphanumeric filtering, paste and caret editing, optional masking and grouping, surface/outline/soft/solid/glass materials, completion events, and shared form states.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Locale-aware single, multiple, and range date-only selection with disabled rules, one or two months, fixed weeks, outside days, and complete grid keyboard navigation.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Typed accessible Balsa-owned drag and snap collection with surface, outline, soft, and glass variants; configurable arrow and indicator placement; orientation, alignment, looping, visible slide count, empty state, and pausable autoplay.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: Responsive semantic-color application navigation with compact item-anchored desktop menus that match its material; surface, outline, soft, and glass materials; bar, floating, and minimal layouts; desktop actions; and static, fixed, or reveal-on-scroll behavior.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Typed grouped application navigation with active state, nested items, expanded/rail/offcanvas desktop modes, shortcut, slots, and Drawer-backed mobile behavior.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Keyboard-accessible outline, surface, soft, or glass single or multiple selection with compact sizing, configurable corners, fixed-height gapped options, and an overflow-safe top-layer listbox.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: Editable outline, surface, soft, or glass single- or multiple-value combobox with shared field sizing, configurable corners, removable selected suggestions, and an overflow-safe suggestion list.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: Labelled locale-formatted single or range date field composing Calendar and collision-safe Popup with validation, disabled dates, clear action, dismissal, focus restoration, and Glassmorphism backdrop blur.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Declarative viewport-level notification stack with primary-by-default typed items, custom icons, bounded rendering, semantic live regions, timed and sticky lifetimes, pause/resume policies, actions, Escape dismissal, position-aware transitions, responsive placement, and teleported theme inheritance.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Button-triggered typed action menus with labels, separators, checkbox/radio state, destructive items, shortcuts, submenus, semantic color, configurable geometry, roving focus, typeahead, and collision-safe portals. Ships PropertySelect, the full-width caption-over-value property row built on the same trigger.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Persistent application menus with horizontal roving focus, open-menu transfer, typed shared menu content, portals, and complete keyboard behavior.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: Inline dropdown or on-demand dialog grouped command filtering with combobox/listbox semantics, active-descendant navigation, hotkey opening, loading, empty states, and typed sizing.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: ColorPicker
items.description: Accessible contrast-safe outline, surface, soft, or glass color field or grouped palette trigger with a custom saturation, hue, and editable HEX, RGB, or HSL color-code popover.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Pointer- and keyboard-positioned typed context actions with viewport collision handling and the complete shared Balsa menu semantics.

items.name: settings-card
items.title: SettingsCard
items.description: Related workspace settings with explicit reset and save actions.

items.name: command-palette-card
items.title: CommandPaletteCard
items.description: Grouped command palette that reaches projects, actions, and settings from one search.

items.name: profile-form-card
items.title: ProfileFormCard
items.description: Labelled profile fields with picture, handle, time zone, and biography.

items.name: environment-switcher-card
items.title: EnvironmentSwitcherCard
items.description: Searchable environment picker with the current selection stated.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Typed columns and rows with render slots, controlled sorting, bottom quick field and advanced filters, pagination, selection, visibility, independent header and row colors, density, loading, empty state, and responsive semantic markup.

items.name: data-grid-card
items.title: DataGridCard
items.description: Sortable, selectable, paginated table of records with real columns.

items.name: preview
items.title: Preview
items.description: Isolated natural or exact logical viewport with fit scaling, synchronized design context, accessible iframe title, and chromeless fullscreen review.

items.name: analytics
items.title: Analytics
items.description: Provider-neutral interaction tracking for every data-balsa component, with consent gating, typed custom events, and adapters for GA4, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, or application-owned destinations.

items.name: charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: Composable responsive Unovis line, area, grouped or stacked bar, donut, and doughnut charts with contrast-safe semantic series, polished interactions, explicit states, and complete semantic table alternatives.

items.name: gradient-background
items.title: GradientBackground
items.description: Deterministic procedural backgrounds with six pattern generators, ASCII and print-style post effects, typed presets, palette-aware colors, calm motion, lifecycle fallbacks, and still PNG capture.

items.name: text-3d
items.title: Text3D
items.description: Palette-aware and theme-aware extruded display text with finite presets, materials, environments and fonts, optional drag, wheel zoom and rotation, lifecycle fallbacks, and still PNG capture.

items.name: application-card
items.title: ApplicationCard
items.description: Structured application surface with a repeatable header, action, body, and footer rhythm that inherits Card material, geometry, borders, density, and elevation.

items.name: error-state-card
items.title: ErrorStateCard
items.description: Recoverable failure with request context and retry action.

items.name: loading-state-card
items.title: LoadingStateCard
items.description: Stable skeleton geometry with accessible busy semantics.

items.name: metric-grid-card
items.title: MetricGridCard
items.description: Aligned operational KPIs with labels, values, and supporting detail.

items.name: storage-usage-card
items.title: StorageUsageCard
items.description: Half-height single measurement with the bar that puts it in context.

items.name: form-progress-card
items.title: FormProgressCard
items.description: Linear multistep progress with current-step semantics.

items.name: incident-alert-card
items.title: IncidentAlertCard
items.description: Half-height incident banner with acknowledge and open actions.

items.name: service-health-card

items.name: activity-timeline-card

items.name: runbook-steps-card

items.name: analytics-chart-card

items.description: Trend visualization with period context and semantic delta.

items.name: asset-carousel-card

items.description: Browsable run of captured assets with captions and review status.

items.name: split-workspace-card

items.name: integration-list-card

items.name: payment-method-card
